right.title: Hayal Neh Ante
right.title_english: You Triumph the Works of Evil
right.description:
Original Song: Hayal Neh Ante
Singer: Liqe Mezemeran Tewodros Yosef

You triumph the works of evil
The mighty angel St. Gebriel
Let the enemy surrender 
Be my rescuing defender

ኃያል ነህ አንተ ኃያል
ደጉ መልአክ ገብርኤል
ይውደቅ ይሸነፍ ጠላት
አንተ ተራዳን በውነት

On the field of Dura 
An idol was arranged 
To favor its worship
A law had been proclaimed
But the wise children had remained faithful and true
They turned to The Most High temptations they subdued 

Frustrated was the king
With the youthful children 
In fire to be burned
He ordered to throw them
Descended down from the heavens as he was sent 
Untouched by the fire he saved them from torment 

They were filled with praises
Beneath the fire pit
The ones that pushed them in
Found themselves within it
They persevered with joy aided by Almighty
The nobles of the king witnessed the Lord’s glory 

Nebuchadnezzar was
Bemused by what he saw
The mighty arch angel
Snatched them out of his claw 
He praised the Lord who sent the angel to save them
He kneeled before their God for worship unto Him

left.description: This mezmur is a joyful call to rejoice in God for His great works of salvation. left.title: Nu Beigziabher
left.description: This mezmur is a joyful call to rejoice in God for His great works of salvation. It celebrates the transition from death to life, from darkness to light, and the gift of the heavenly kingdom. Drawing from biblical imagery such as water from the rock and manna from heaven, it highlights God's provision and faithfulness. The chant also honors the role of the Virgin Mary in bringing this light into the world, encouraging believers to trust in God without fear and to give thanks continually for His love, mercy, and salvation.

right.description:
Original song: Qana ZeGelila
Original Singer: Kesis Mindaye Birhanu


Cana of Galilee (2) in the matrimony
Virgin we have found you with divinity 
Our Lord we have found you with our Lady

Invited were the crowds flooding through the foyer
Celebrating they ate emptied the wine chamber 
Our Holy Virgin the Mother of our Lord 
For your mediation it is you they implored

With you in attendance ashamed they will not feel
Nothing is beneath you fill with wine their barrel
“They have no wine” you said to your son our Lord 
It is our Mother we cherish and adore 

Divinity of Lord that was unveiled to us
How fortunate it was the house of Dokimas 
And today in the home of this grand unity 
Blessings have spilled to us, with His humility 

Transfigured was the wine when it was just water 
In Cana Galilee our eyes did not falter 
If we ensure that He remains within our midst
Good wine will overflow as written in the scripts

በጌቴ ሰማኔ በአትክልቱ ቦታ/2/
ለእኛ ሲል ጌታችን በዓለም ተንገላታ/2/
አዳምና ሔዋን ባጠፉት ጥፋት/2/
በእኛ ላይ ደረሰ የዘልዓለም ሞት/2/
መስቀል ተሸክሞ ሲወጣ ተራራ/2/
ይገርፉት ነበረ ሁሉም በየተራ/2/
ተጠማሁ/3/ ሲላቸው/2/
ኮምጣጤ አመጡለት በሀሞት ደባልቀው/2/
ድንግል አልቻችም እንባዋን ልትገታ/2/
እያየች በመስቀል ልጇ ሲንገላታ/2/
በአምላክነቱ ሳይፈርድባቸው/2/
እንዲህ ሲል ጸለየ አባት ሆይ ማራቸው/2/
በረቂቅ ጥበቡ ሁሉን የፈጠረ/2/
በሰዎች ተገርፎ ሞቶ ተቀበረ/2/
